steps.content:
Clock cabinet, sculpture, flames, hostages...
You feel the blood seeping, a girl sobbing, the life-threatening danger lingering in the flames and slowly approaching you...
Whose dream is this again?

The details of the dream seem so vague. You cannot help but think of what Chameleon said in the interrogation room,
"If there's something you feel you've forgotten, feel free to come to me for advice..."
When you wake up, your intuition tells you to go seek clarification from Chameleon.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I knew you would come.
Chameleon leisurely puts on her <color=#e45515>glasses</color>. She seems to be unaffected even after being in confinement for so long.

options: What have you done to me?
How did you know I would be coming here?

choices.text: What have you done to me?
How did you know I would be coming here?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: It wasn't me, but you yourself.
She puts away her smile and reveals a look of deep grief that you've never seen before.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Your shackles have created some kind of connection between us.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I sensed that you entered my dream.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Because I saw you entering my dream.
She puts away her smile and reveals a look of deep grief that you've never seen before.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: It must have been your shackles that established some kind of connection between us.
She does not look like she was lying. Did you really see Chameleon's past? Does it have anything to do with her crime?
However, your residual memories of that dream are so vague that you only remember fragments. The clock cabinet, the sculpture, and the flames—they are not enough to recreate what she went through.
You already predicted that I would forget some things since the last interrogation. Was it really not intentionally planned by you?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I admit that I like to make jokes at you sometimes.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: But are you not curious about how I awakened to be a Sinner? Would you not like to know the connection?
I remember seeing a clock cabinet in the dream. Did that belong to you?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: That was one of my father's vintage clocks. The clock pendulum would make a dull ringing sound...
She softly pushes her <color=#e45515>glasses</color>, sounding a bit nostalgic.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: My parents were both psychologists, but they didn't want me to pursue their profession.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: When I was young, I hid in the clock cabinet and peeked through the cracks to see how they would consult their patients.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: And do you remember the sculpture on the desk in the dream?
It's an exquisite stone statue of about thirty centimeters in height.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Hypnos, the god of dreams, could make people fall into slumber and sweet dreams.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Dignified, holy, immaculate... My parents had extremely high demands on their profession, and all treatments were conducted under the supervision of the god of dreams.
Chameleon's description of the clock cabinet and the sculpture is somehow different from what you saw in your dream...
As if to give an answer to your unease, she shows a bitter smile.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Unfortunately, some patients did not trust that their psychiatrists would keep their unpleasant secrets.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Everything I just talked about was destroyed in fire.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: The white marble sculpture was stained with blood after being smashed to the back of their heads. The clock cabinet cut me off from my parents, the murderer, and the sea of fire. We fell into two different worlds.
When the blurred memories are pieced together with Chameleon's guidance, a new picture flashes through your mind.
A thin man tied to a chair is in what seems to be an abandoned depot.
Is there nothing else apart from this experience in your dreams?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I will awaken when the flames begin to dance... Do you still not believe me, Chief?
She does not seem to know about that man.
I saw something different in your dream.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Is that so? I would wake up after the big fire, so I can't remember anything after that...
There seems to be a "hostage" tied up in a remote location...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: A remote location... What exactly is that referring to?
There seems to be some unusual excitement in her tone.
I don't remember... Could this be important to you?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Of course it is. It wasn't easy to help you recall your memories...
It's nothing. I was just a little lost in thought.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Really?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: I thought you finally remembered something about the "hostage."

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: That's weird... I was so "sincere" in helping you restore your memories. Has it not taken effect yet?
What do you mean?
She just faintly smiles and pushes her <color=#e45515>glasses</color>. The reflection of her lens is extremely blinding for some reason and you feel dizzy.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: You were also curious, right? Who was that man? Where was he tied up? Why is he appearing in your memories?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Trust me. Just do as I say... and I'll help you remember it...
Your eyelids become uncontrollably heavy, and Chameleon's face starts to get blurry.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Don't worry. Do as you're told. Get some sleep and you'll remember everything.
A flash of white light passes and you find yourself in an unfamiliar environment.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Welcome to your subconscious world, Chief.
My subconscious? Weren't we talking about your dreams?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Take it easy. It's too early to reveal the answer.

You look around but do not see Chameleon.
The hypnotist's bewildering voice only exists inside your mind and you no longer hear any traces of the sadness and nostalgia from earlier.
You've been acting all this time just for this moment when you can hypnotize me.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Shh, I'm busy with something right now and am not in the mood to bicker with you.
As soon as Chameleon says that, a woman with a cane steps out of the darkness.
You shouldn't have abused your authority to come here even if you're the chief of the MBCC.
Who is she?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: The person who will give me the answer.
You seem to also know the woman in front of you, but cannot clearly see her face hidden under the brim of her hat.

options: Observe and try to save yourself

choices.text: Observe and try to save yourself

steps.content: You have too many questions. "Who are you? Where is this? How do I escape from Chameleon's control and return to reality?"
However, before you are able to speak, the hypnotist's command rings in your head.
This archive feels familiar—the files are arranged like those in the MBCC.
However, before you are able to determine if that is the case, the hypnotist's command rings in your head.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Chief, tell this nosy woman that you are here to interrogate Chameleon regarding the whereabouts of the "hostage."
You repeat Chameleon's words reluctantly. After all, this is her home turf.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Good. Come, let's hear what she has to say to that.
Your resistance proved futile as this is Chameleon's home turf.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Good, don't waste your energy. Why don't we listen to what she has to say to that?
The hostage is being held in an abandoned depot on the border of Eastside, which can be found by walking south along the Rust.
The mysterious person says that while handing the document in hand to you.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: This woman cannot be trusted. It's best you confirm the document's contents.
The hypnotist puts tremendous pressure on you, forcing you to look down and open the document in your hand.

Chameleon, female, born on February 14, N.F. 86, is a psychology professor at Banyan Medical College and is currently serving as a special psychology consultant for the 9th Agency.
Special ability: Tampering with the subconscious mind of others.
Profile:
Her father Dane Theseus and mother Lilian Theseus were both graduates of Banyan Medical College who specialized in subconscious therapy. They have had a private psychological clinic since N.F. 84.
In N.F. 96, <color=#e45515>the Theseuses</color> were murdered and the clues were destroyed by fire. Their daughter Chameleon was found in a coma inside the clock cabinet.
 <color=#e45515>The murderer and arson suspect Oris</color>, a key councilor in Paradeisos, was released at the end due to a lack of evidence.

In N.F. 106, the murderer's wife and parents cut ties with him for unspecified reasons. After losing the <color=#e45515>Jacknal family's </color>asylum, he lost his residency in Paradeisos and was deported.
In N.F. 107, the 9th Agency found Oris mind-controlled in Chameleon's private clinic <color=#e45515>and secretly held him hostage at the agency's old depot</color>. In the same year, Chameleon accepted an invitation from the 9th Agency to provide guidance in criminal psychology.
In N.F. 111, a group of civilians from the Jacknal family suffered from auditory hallucinations, which are a sequela of hypnosis. They were suspected to have been <color=#e45515>tampered with subconsciously</color>.
In N.F. 112, Chameleon was formally arrested by the 9th Agency on suspicion of tampering with others' subconscious and was transferred to the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: The old depot of the agency, very good... You've done a good job, Chief...
Chameleon contently repeats the address and her voice gets softer each time.
No one responds, and the voice looking down on the subconscious word is now completely silent.
Chameleon?
End the hypnosis now.
Chameleon!
What do you think she's going to do after she got this information?
?! Are... Are you talking to me?
There are only the two of us here.
Didn't you exist in the subconscious memory? How could you possibly...
Answer me. What do you think her objective is?
Her authoritative voice compels you to answer.

options: Going to the depot for the hostage

steps.content: But I'm stuck in this dream. How am I supposed to stop her?
Instead of answering your question directly, she gives a statement, trying to make you less confused.
The dreaming one is not her, but you.
What you see in hypnosis is the extraction and processing of actual memories.
I still don't get it...
Being in the subconscious world, you must be able to find those things that were forgotten.
Forgotten things? What did you forget?

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: You scared me, Chief. What are you doing here so late instead of sleeping?
I have a classified mission. I need to go to the higher-classified archive to request clearance.

steps.speaker: Guard
steps.content: I see. Your eyes were half-closed, so I thought you were sleepwalking... Do you need me to notify Adjutant Nightingale?
No need. Keep this a secret from everyone.
Is this your memory? How come you seem to have no recollection of it at all?

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: You will find an opportunity to go to the 9th Agency's archive alone and investigate the hostage's whereabouts...
Okay... I will go to the higher-classified archive and investigate the hostage's whereabouts...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: You will forget some details and use the remaining memory fragments for the dream in our spiritual connection...
I will forget some details and use the remaining memory fragments for the dream in our spiritual connection...

steps.speaker: Chameleon
steps.content: Very good. Next, you will see Nightingale enter the interrogation room and will be subjected to Sinners' disdain and blame...
If I guessed correctly, she will lie to you that it was all a dream. But in fact, it was real.
Yes...

What terrifies you even more is that every topic she mentioned, be it spiritual connections, dreams, reluctance to be interrogated, or childhood nightmares, was deliberately crafted to steer you. Her every little gesture was calculated.
I'm sure you know what to do next.
The woman raises her cane and taps the document in your hand.
Remember to leave the document behind before you leave. Be careful as it is the key to the dangerous door.
Wait!
You still have unanswered questions.

options: Why didn't she kill her enemy back then?
Who are you? How are you able to talk to me?

choices.text: Why didn't she kill her enemy back then?
Who are you? How are you able to talk to me?

steps.content: Instead of letting Oris fall into the hands of the 9th as leverage and going to great lengths to get the info, why didn't she kill her enemy at the very first?
Even Chameleon had no access to these documents and had to use me to get the information. How did you know about all this?
Not only do you know Chameleon, but you also seem to know me well. It's like you predicted I would go into my own memories, so that you leave these words as a reminder. Who exactly are you?
She does not respond to you.
(Thud)
With the sound of the cane hitting the ground, you feel dizzy again.
You are back in the confinement room. Sure enough, Chameleon is not there anymore.

options: Call Nightingale to apprehend the Sinner!

choices.text: Call Nightingale to apprehend the Sinner!

steps.content: Nightingale! Send guards immediately to apprehend Chameleon. She's escaped.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Chameleon? Weren't you in the confinement room?
I underestimated her first hypnosis.
Chameleon's ability is not simply hypnosis, but rather the distortion and manipulation of the subconscious world. She tampered with my subconscious actions and even my memories.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But haven't you already put shackles on her and confiscated her pocket watch?
Since she could manipulate you without your knowledge, it shouldn't have been difficult for her to unlock the shackles and fool all the MBCC guards.
Not to mention, the pocket watch isn't her only hypnosis prop. You remember the pair of gold-rimmed glasses that made you feel uneasy.
Damn, I don't have enough time to explain now! Go south along the Rust. Chameleon went to the 9th Agency's old depot!
The 9th must have their reasons for keeping her away from the hostage. Hurry, we must stop her.
Chameleon might well have killed the hostage and even...
Even committed evil acts that you cannot speculate or control for now.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Be careful as it is the key to the dangerous door.
